subject: Final Splice: One-time usage bonus for conversion

Subject: Final Splice: One-time usage bonus for conversion

Alex / Priya —

Quick note: FairPlay has shown strong engagement in the POC and product usage is trending the way we expected. To give your team runway for the final evaluation and to accelerate the purchase decision, we can offer a one-time usage credit and a short trial extension:

- 25,000 token credit applied to the pilot account (one-time, non-recurring)
- 30-day trial extension from today
- Standard support and a pre-scheduled health check with Monica during the extension

Conditions: signed addendum by end-of-week (EOW Fri 23 Jul) and a short acceptance note from your procurement team. I attached a brief proposal that summaries the scope and deliverables.

If you want a higher cap we can discuss but will need a manager sign-off — happy to loop Markus.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
Attachments: fairplay_proposal_v2.pdf (pdf)

Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final Splice: One-time usage bonus for conversion

Thanks Ben — appreciate the flexibility. A couple quick questions before we escalate internally:

1) Can you confirm whether the 25k token credit is refundable or transferable if we don't consume it within the extended trial window?
2) After the credit runs out or expires, what will our committed pricing look like (ballpark)? We need to show finance a delta.
3) Can you provide a simple SLA for latency/uptime for the pilot period (we won't sign without an acceptable reliability target).

Priya and I are aligned that something in the 20–25k range makes sense; if you can accelerate internal approval for 25k and supply the SLA text, we'll push procurement to sign by EOW.

-- Alex
Alex D'Souza
Head of Platform, FairPlay AI

Ben / Monica —

Greenlight on a maximum of 25,000 token one-time credit and the 30-day extension with the following conditions:

- Credit expires 60 days after issuance if unused (no refund, non-transferable).
- Legal to use standard pilot addendum (I reviewed; no custom clauses).
- SLA for pilot period: best-effort 99.5% availability for API endpoints; 95th percentile latency target of <=120ms for inference under the pilot profile. Monica, please confirm ops readiness for monitoring and that we can include this wording in the addendum.
- Track this spend as a deal-level concession in HubSpot and attach approval_sheet.xlsx (attached).

Once Monica confirms SLA tweet and signs off on the monitoring plan I'll authorize Ben to finalize and send to the customer.
